educationalGoal: Global PD is a service-learning design course in which teams of students from across the world work together on 2 weeks projects that benefit the community. Students use the Design Thinking methodology to co-create innovative solutions to real-life issues. Through this project, students should be able to apply their teamwork and communication skills, develop a better understanding of themselves, fostering empathy for the community, and realize the positive impact for the community in need.
advice:
In Global PD, students will learn and experience:

[Multidisciplinary Design]
- Learn how to be better designers, gain design knowledge and skills.
- Learn how to identify and acquire new knowledge
- Learn to collaborate with people from other disciplines and develop an appreciation for cross-disciplinary contributions in design.

[Professional Preparation]
- Develop a broad set of skills needed to be successful in the changing global societies

[Service-Learning]
- Provide significant service to the community while learning
- Gain an understanding of the role that engineering and their discipline can play in society

achievementLevels.ideal:
After the completion of this course, students will be able to
- understand of design as a start-to-finish process
- use an ability to identify and acquire new knowledge as a part of the problem-solving/design process in community-based projects
-  foster an ability to function on multidisciplinary teams and an appreciation for the contributions from individuals from multiple disciplines
- get an ability to communicate effectively both orally and written with widely-varying backgrounds
- find an appreciation of the role that their discipline can play in social contexts

              Global PD is a service-learning design course in which teams of students from across the world work together on 2 weeks projects that benefit the community. Students use the Design Thinking methodology to co-create innovative solutions to real-life issues. Through this project, students should be able to apply their teamwork and communication skills, develop a better understanding of themselves, fostering empathy for the community, and realize the positive impact for the community in need.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              In Global PD, students will learn and experience:

[Multidisciplinary Design]
- Learn how to be better designers, gain design knowledge and skills.
- Learn how to identify and acquire new knowledge
- Learn to collaborate with people from other disciplines and develop an appreciation for cross-disciplinary contributions in design.

[Professional Preparation]
- Develop a broad set of skills needed to be successful in the changing global societies

[Service-Learning]
- Provide significant service to the community while learning
- Gain an understanding of the role that engineering and their discipline can play in society

              教科書および参考書・リザーブドブック

1) Change by Design, Revised and Updated: How Design Thinking Transforms Organizations and Inspires Innovation, Tim Brown, Harper Business(2019)
2) Tsutawaru design no Kihon / Basics and Rules for Commnunication materials, Yuma Takahashi, Natsu Katayama, Gijutsuhyouronsya(1996) , in Japanese

              履修に必要な予備知識や技能

              In Global PD, students are encouraged to work together and share information under multi-disciplinary, cross-cultural settings. Since, we expect every student to practice honorable, ethical, and professional behavior both inside and outside the classroom.
